mapper.select: select distinct p.permission_code from sys_user u join sys_role r on json_contains(u.role_ids, cast(r.role_id as json)) join sys_permission p on json_contains(r.permission_ids, cast(p.permission_id as json)) where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_status=1;
select user_id from sys_user where username = #{username} and password = #{password} and user_status = 1 limit 1
